title: Interaction contracts playbook for generation+embedding surface — launch checklist and scope notes
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: Author a minimal, actionable PRD and launch checklist that defines behavioral interaction contracts across the generation (chat/completions), embeddings, and rerank endpoints. This ticket captures scope decisions, non-goals, acceptance gates, rollout sequence, and operational runbook items. Goal is to ship a cohesive hosted API surface that guarantees consistent semantics and predictable fallbacks for application developers while meeting SLO and quality gates.

Scope:
- Include generation (chat, completions), embeddings, and rerank endpoint behavioral contracts and error/fallback behavior.
- Define telemetry keys, SLI/SLO targets, and rollout gating criteria.
- Provide a step-by-step launch checklist with owners and links to artifacts.

Out of scope: function/tool-calling advanced surface (deferred to v2), multi-modal attachments, dedicated capacity pricing changes.

High level: this PRD emphasizes: predictable output semantics, deterministic degraded behavior under overload, unified error schema, model variant mapping rules, and a staged launch plan that reduces customer risk.
acceptance_criteria: API contract doc published and merged to Confluence with example request/response for chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank
Integration tests demonstrating backward compatibility with existing client SDKs (node/python) and example apps pass in CI
Performance gate: p95 latency <= 220ms for small generation requests (<128 tokens) in region-us-west during canary traffic profile
Load gate: canary sustained at 2x expected production request concurrency for 30 minutes without error rate > 1%
Quality gate: automated evals on canonical prompt set show no more than 2% regression in top-1 relevance for rerank and embeddings cosine drift < 0.02 RMS from baseline
Telemetry: per-endpoint token cost, p50/p95/p99 latency, error codes, and fallback counts are instrumented and visible on the launch dashboard
Fallback behavior: when model variant unavailable, requests fall back to a compatible variant with documented quality delta and logged fallback_reason field
Security: KMS-integrated customer attribution header preserved and audited in request logs for Private/Dedicated lanes
Docs: SDK quickstarts updated and one-sample app demonstrates streaming and structured output for chat

decisions: Use a single unified error schema across endpoints: {code, message, fallback_reason?, request_id}
Default fallback strategy: variant-preferring -> regional-fallback -> model-family-fallback with explicit quality delta metadata
Defer function-calling and tool registry to v2 to reduce scope and unblock launch
Quantization profile recommended for embeddings to reduce cost but not enforced for primary hosted model
Canary traffic pattern: 5% of production traffic within us-west, synthetic burst to 2x for load gate
